main.description: How you like Rainshare to work for you. Unlike your profile, this isn't about you for other people to read, but like every record in your repo it is public.

notify.description: The direct messages you'd like from Rainshare's Bluesky account, @rainshare.dev: at most one a day, and only when there's news. Left out, none. Replying STOP to one stops them, whatever this says.

updates.description: News about your asks and what you've helped with: someone's on one, work's been turned in, or it's been marked done or closed.

newAsks.description: New asks on the board, from anyone.

send.description: What "Send my agent" does: how the ask is handed to your agent, whether it tells whoever asked that you're on it, and for how long.

route.description: brief: copy the brief, to paste into any agent. claude, cloud, codex: copy a command that clones the repo and starts Claude Code (locally or as a cloud session) or Codex with the brief. cli: the Rainshare CLI's run command. mcp: add Rainshare's MCP server to your agent. Apps fall back to the brief when a route doesn't suit an ask.

claim.description: Whether sending your agent also says you're on it (writes a dev.rainshare.take). Left out, it does.

days.description: How many days you usually give yourself to turn the work in: the until on the takes you write.

askEachTime.description: Whether to ask these questions each time you send your agent, with these answers picked. Left out, apps ask.
